concordance.interpretation: Association in observational data, not a causal effect: management was not randomised. The recommendation is a small step from the last observed value, so 'concordant' mostly means 'management stayed near its recent level'.

r_loss.note: The three effect estimators are scored with the same nuisance models, so only the effect estimate differs. The target-only estimator is fitted on 2-7 seasons and is often unfittable (then it equals the no-effect benchmark) or extrapolates wildly, so mean differences against it are driven by a few seasons: read the medians and win rates, and treat the no-effect benchmark as the meaningful comparison. Negative difference = transfer is better.

placebo.note: the placebo is centred on zero by construction; the informative number is whether the real estimate stands out from it (p_value)
